risks.title: Dependence on UK residential real estate regulation
risks.score_rationale: Although the provided text is primarily administrative (AGM, special dividend), Berkeley Group operates in the highly regulated UK residential real estate sector. The absence of explicit discussion of regulatory risks in this excerpt suggests omission of a full Item 1A, but this risk is fundamental for a property developer. Moderate language intensity (implicit). Stable but structural trend.

risks.title: Volatility in property prices and market cycles
risks.score_rationale: Core business risk for a property developer. Economic cycles directly affect demand, selling prices, and margins. Implicitly central to core operations. Moderate language but high impact on project viability. Stable but cyclical trend.

risks.title: Supply chain risks and construction costs
risks.score_rationale: Critical operational risk for a property developer. Dependence on material suppliers, labor, and subcontractors. Cost volatility (steel, concrete, energy) directly impacts margins. Implicit language but high impact post-COVID and amid inflation. Upward trend (inflationary).

risks.title: Land availability and acquisition cost risks
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific business risk in residential real estate. Availability of developable land at competitive prices is critical for pipeline growth. Implicit language but fundamental to development strategy. Stable but structural trend (UK land constraints).

risks.title: Litigation and real estate regulatory compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Inherent business risk in real estate (construction defects, buyer disputes, regulatory compliance). Moderate language (implicit in operations). Stable but structurally present. Medium category weight for the sector.

risks.title: Dependence on financing and access to mortgage credit
risks.score_rationale: Critical business risk for a property developer. Reliance on project financing and buyers' ability to secure mortgages. Implicit language but high impact on sales and cash flow. Upward trend (credit tightening post-2022). High category weight.

risks.title: Environmental risks and construction sustainability
risks.score_rationale: Growing business risk for the real estate sector. Energy performance standards (Building Regulations, Future Homes Standard), physical climate risks (flooding), ESG requirements. Implicit language but upward trend (strengthened environmental regulation). Medium-high category weight.

risks.title: Reputation risks and social acceptance of projects
risks.score_rationale: Business risk for a developer operating in urban areas. Local opposition to projects, criticism over affordability, community impact. Implicit language but upward trend (increased sensitivity to social issues). Medium category weight.
